name: Into the Woods
address: 3501 S. Tamiami Trail Suite 1175, Sarasota, FL 34239
blurb: Sondheim and Lapine's fairy-tale mash-up opens this Thursday at Rise Above Performing Arts' new theater on South Tamiami Trail, next to Connors Steak & Seafood. Eight performances across two weekends — evenings at 7:30 and Sunday matinees at 2:30 — with tickets running about $22 to $35. Familiar characters up front, a much deeper second act, and an easy night out for families with older kids.

name: Sarasota Anime-Fest
hours_label: 10 AM – 5 PM · $20 (one child 11 & under free per paid adult)
blurb: A one-day, air-conditioned fandom convention at Robarts Arena: anime and manga vendors, retro toys and video games, artist tables, apparel, cosplay contests, lip sync and trivia. Admission is $20 at the door or in advance, and one child 11 and under gets in free with each paid adult. An easy indoor pick for families on a hot August Saturday.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Downtown Sarasota's Saturday-morning staple: fresh produce, flowers, baked goods, coffee and local makers spread along Lemon Avenue and Main Street. Free to browse and dog-friendly — and the single easiest way to see downtown at its liveliest. Go early to beat the August heat.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
blurb: Sarasota's most-photographed weekly ritual: drummers, dancers, hula hoopers and a few hundred onlookers gather on the quartz sand just south of the Siesta Beach pavilion as the sun drops into the Gulf. Free, no experience needed, and bringing your own drum is encouraged. Park early — the lot fills well before sunset.
